title: AI Agents: The Mind-Blowing Loop Explained #shorts
description: Discover the powerful agent work loop: Goal, Plan, Tools, Execute, Check, Retry, Finish. This iterative process allows AI agents to tackle complex tasks continuously, unlike single-answer systems. #AI #AgentWork #TechExplained #ArtificialIntelligence #Automation
transcript: How do they work? So, most agent work works in a loop. So, you have goal, plan, tools, execute, check, retry, and finish. So, goal, you tell it what you want. Plan, it breaks the goal into steps. Tools, it uses browser, email, docs, calendar, etc. Execute, does one step. Check, did it work? Retry or adjust, if not, tries again. Then you got the last step, which is finish. Stops when complete or blocked. And that loop is why agents are so powerful. They can keep working through a task chain instead of stopping after one answer. And that is what blew my mind when I watched that video.
